summary: The audit checks the five core breadth areas, three advanced A/A courses of 3 or more units, two mathematics courses for six units (any MATH course numbered 200 or above also counts), 3 units of experimentation and design, and a 3-unit free elective at the 100 level or above, with letter grades everywhere except seminars and the free elective. Your graduate units must reach 45; courses below the 100 level and AA 290 units past six do not count. You move in the 12 units of advisor-approved technical electives and check the 2.75 GPA by hand. Distinction in Research is optional. Left: a Distinction in Research student may count up to 12 units of AA 290, but the audit still stops at six.
